subject: Compliance add-on pilot — pricing breakdown and pilot concession request

From: Elena Martinez <elena@acmehealth.com>

Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Question on compliance add-on pricing for HIPAA/HSM pilot

Hi Soojin,

Quick one — the security/compliance pricing sheet you shared last week was helpful but our procurement team has a few clarifying questions before we move to SOW:

- Can you break out audit logs by retention tiers (30/90/365 days) and the per-GB or per-user math?
- How do you price KMS/HSM seats vs per-encryption-ops? We expect to rotate keys across regions.
- Data residency: we need EU residency for patient records for our EU subsidiary — is that an additional flat fee or separate residency instance?
- Pilots: are you able to offer a short evaluation concession (pilot discount) for the first 90 days while we run latency/accuracy tests? If so, what are the standard constraints (commit after pilot, minimum MRR, etc.)?

We want to get an internal buy-in to proceed to legal, so a short written reply outlining options and the tradeoffs would be great.

Thanks —
Elena
Elena Martinez
Head of Security & Compliance, AcmeHealth
elena@acmehealth.com

Subject: Re: Question on compliance add-on pricing for HIPAA/HSM pilot

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the clear list. Below is a concise breakdown and a pilot option we typically offer for evaluations like yours. I've attached an updated pricing spreadsheet (compliance_addon_pricing_v3.xlsx) and a draft SOW for reference.

Audit logs (retention tiers):
- 30 days: included in base audit tier at $0.00/GB (first 10GB/mo included), $0.10/GB after.
- 90 days: $0.08/GB for additional retention beyond 30d.
- 365 days: $0.06/GB beyond 90d.
Notes: We can also offer rolling windows and lifecycle policies to move older logs to lower-cost storage.

KMS/HSM pricing:
- KMS integration (per-region): $1,000/month per region for managed key integration + $0.00005/encryption-op.
- Dedicated HSM seat (FIPS/HSM-backed): $3,500/month per HSM instance (strong SLA).
- For pilot usage we can provide a managed KMS connector at no charge; HSM seats are typically charged but see pilot concession below.

Data residency:
- EU residency instance: one-time provisioning fee $5,000 + $2,500/month for reserved capacity footprint.
- Alternatively, cross-region routing with per-request residency controls is available (adds ~6% to per-token unit costs).

Pilot concession (our recommended path):
- 90-day pilot with 30% off listed addon fees, subject to:
  1) Pilot uses <= 2 HSM seats and <= 300GB/month audit logs (so we don't materially provision long-lived HSM capacity).
  2) Customer signs a 12-month reserved-capacity commitment within 30 days after pilot completes to receive the pilot discount as a one-time credit applied to first 3 months of production billing.
  3) Pilot metrics we track: p50/p95 latency, token-cost delta vs baseline, and error rate.
- If AcmeHealth needs HSMs fully dedicated during the pilot, we can reduce the concession to 15% or convert to a time-limited credit instead.

Next steps: happy to join a 30-min call with procurement and security to walk the spreadsheet and map to your expected volumes. If you prefer, we can issue a short pilot amendment to the SoW to lock in the concession and limits.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Marissa / Ben — forwarding Elena's request and my summary below.

Summary: customer (AcmeHealth) wants 90-day pilot with HSM and EU residency. Soojin proposed 30% pilot discount with constraints: <=2 HSM seats and 300GB logs/month, and a 12-month commit afterwards. Deal id ACM-2027-058.

Ask: can we approve 30% off add-on fees for the pilot and allow HSM seat as a free managed connector during pilot? If not, what's the maximum concession you can sign off without further legal escalation?

Notes: AcmeHealth is strategic (multi-region healthcare customer) — winning this with reasonable concessions unlocks a larger dedicated deployment.

-Karthik

Subject: Re: Fwd: Compliance add-on pilot — pricing breakdown and pilot concession request

Karthik — thanks for the context. I spoke with finance briefly. Proposed adjustment:

- Approve a pilot concession but reduce to 20-30% (lean toward 30% only if customer commits up front to a 12-month reserved capacity at agreed minimum MRR).
- Offer managed KMS connector complimentary for the pilot.
- Dedicated HSM seats: bill at 50% for months 1-2, then revert to full price unless a longer-term commitment is signed. (We need to avoid long unpaid HSM provisioning.)

If Soojin confirms Acme can sign a 12-month reserved-commit LOI (minimum $30k/mo) post-pilot, we can stick with the 30% credit applied to the first three billed months. Otherwise, default to 20% and stricter usage caps.

Loop in legal on the SoW amendment and procurement on payment terms.

-Marissa

From: Elena Martinez <elena@acmehealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmehealth.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance add-on pilot — pricing breakdown and pilot concession request

Soojin / Marissa — thanks for the clear options. Procurement ran the numbers and here's our counter:

- We can agree to a 12-month reserved-capacity LOI if the production pricing after the pilot is capped (within 10% of the quoted reserved MRR) and if latency SLOs are met during the pilot (p95 < 400ms for our typical workload).
- For the pilot we accept 20% off add-on fees and request the managed KMS connector be provided at no charge.
- We ask that 1 HSM seat be included free for the first 60 days (to validate flows) and that HSM pricing thereafter be the standard rate unless we convert to a dedicated HSM with the commit.

If that aligns with your final SoW wording we can have procurement sign the pilot amendment and move to SOW review next week.

Regards,
Elena Martinez
Head of Security & Compliance, AcmeHealth
